versions.change_zh: 六卡 TP2×PP3 初始跑通；Engram 按行读盘
versions.result_zh: Prefill 约 375–380 tok/s 封顶；先证明能跑，瓶颈在取表与流水等待。
versions.change_en: Initial six-GPU TP2×PP3 pipeline; per-row Engram disk reads
versions.result_en: Prefill plateaued around 375–380 tok/s; lookup and pipeline waits dominated.

versions.change_zh: Engram 远程常驻内存取表，随后调优 NCCL
versions.result_zh: 8K Prefill 225.5→2082.0；NCCL 调优后 32K 为 3621.6 tok/s，Decode 约 25.6。
versions.change_en: Resident remote Engram gather, followed by NCCL tuning
versions.result_en: 8K Prefill 225.5→2082.0; tuned 32K Prefill 3621.6 tok/s, Decode about 25.6.

versions.change_zh: 6000D 移至末段，启用 DSpark；特殊配比分层
versions.result_zh: 30K Prefill 4883；普通文本单流 Decode 41.4–42.8 tok/s；显存限制上下文。
versions.change_en: Move the 6000D pair to the final stage; enable DSpark with a special layer allocation
versions.result_en: 30K Prefill 4883; ordinary-text single-stream Decode 41.4–42.8 tok/s; limited memory headroom.

versions.change_zh: 关闭 DSpark，缩小分块、固定 KV 预算，优先长上下文容量
versions.result_zh: 12×149437 输入均完成；单流 Prefill 5062、Decode 35.0 tok/s；峰值实际生成并发只有 5。
versions.change_en: Disable DSpark, reduce chunk size and reserve KV memory for long context
versions.result_en: 12×149437-token inputs completed; C1 Prefill 5062 and Decode 35.0 tok/s; observed running peak only 5.

versions.change_zh: 跨段 KV 镜像＋重新配比分层，恢复 DSpark 与 8192 分块
versions.result_zh: 12 路长输入＋每路 512 输出全部完成，215.19 秒；单流 150K Prefill 约 3860 tok/s。
versions.change_en: Cross-stage KV mirroring and revised placement restore DSpark and 8192-token chunks
versions.result_en: 12 long-input requests with 512 output tokens each completed in 215.19 s; C1 150K Prefill about 3860 tok/s.

versions.change_zh: 转向 PD：双 6000D 负责输入计算，四 Spark TP4 解码；修 P2P、GPU 取表及 NIXL
versions.result_zh: P 单流阶段速率达到约 13K–16.5K；PD 输入阶段仍有尾部补算和交接开销；冻结黄金恢复点。
versions.change_en: Switch to PD: dual 6000D Prefill plus four-Spark TP4 Decode; repair P2P, GPU gather and NIXL
versions.result_en: P single-request stage rate about 13K–16.5K tok/s; end-to-end input still pays handoff and tail replay; golden checkpoint frozen.

versions.change_zh: 按代码负载选定参数；D 侧预取与 GPU stage、tail=1280；封装镜像并补看门狗
versions.result_zh: 8K/32K × C1/C4/C8/C12 正式压测 100/100；同配置 C8 相对直连 TP4 的聚合 Decode 为 2.00×/4.45×。
versions.change_en: Select code-serving settings, D prefetch/GPU staging and tail=1280; package images and add a watchdog
versions.result_en: 100/100 requests in the 8K/32K × C1/C4/C8/C12 matrix; matched C8 aggregate Decode 2.00×/4.45× direct TP4.
